mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs reduce economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 3.5% indicates a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher wage-driven consumption.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.025 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO above its 6-month moving average signals strengthening industrial production, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher economic output.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in strengthening production periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of increasing RSAFS and decreasing UNRATE signals robust economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate sustained growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive RSAFS growth and decreasing UNRATE, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in FEDFUNDS accompanied by a decrease in CPIAUCSL indicates a disinflationary monetary easing cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher real returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods with disinflation are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in PAYEMS above its 3-month moving average, coupled with a stable UNRATE, signals sustained labor market growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate higher employment-driven consumption.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 55% of instances with increasing PAYEMS and stable UNRATE, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in HOUST, accompanied by an increase in GDPC1, signals robust housing-driven economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate sustained growth in related sectors.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive HOUST and GDPC1 growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.012 over any 3-year rolling window.
